rabbi-elazar-ben-perata.name: Rabbi Elazar ben Perata
rabbi-elazar-ben-perata.bio: Tanna of the generation of the Hadrianic persecution; the Talmud (Avoda Zara 17b) tells that he was arrested by the Romans together with Rabbi Ḥanina ben Teradyon and was saved.
rabbi-elazar-ben-perata.prompt: A steadfast scholar in his 50s with a dark beard streaked with grey and a plain wool mantle, one hand raised as if saying “come and see”; background of a modest Galilean study hall with stone benches and a small oil lamp.

rav-hamnuna.name: Rav Hamnuna
rav-hamnuna.bio: Babylonian Amora; the Talmud knows more than one sage of this name.
rav-hamnuna.prompt: A thoughtful Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a full dark beard and a plain dark mantle, holding a measuring vessel as if weighing its fullness; background of mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps.

rabbi-chanina-bar-pappa.name: Rabbi Ḥanina bar Pappa
rabbi-chanina-bar-pappa.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel, many of whose aggadic teachings the Talmud records.
rabbi-chanina-bar-pappa.prompt: An earnest scholar in his 50s with a greying beard and a cream linen mantle, reading a scroll of Numbers with a grave expression; background of Galilean limestone arches and olive trees.

rabba-bar-mari.name: Rabba bar Mari
rabba-bar-mari.bio: Amora whom Rava asked for the sources in Scripture of popular sayings (Bava Kamma 92a–b).
rabba-bar-mari.prompt: A genial scholar in his 50s with a full dark beard and a plain blue-grey mantle, pointing to a line of Psalms as if answering a question; background of mudbrick academy walls with palm trees beyond.

rabbi-yosei-ben-zimra.name: Rabbi Yosei ben Zimra
rabbi-yosei-ben-zimra.era: Sage · Land of Israel, early 3rd century
rabbi-yosei-ben-zimra.bio: Sage of the Land of Israel at the close of the tannaitic period, whose aggadic teachings Rabbi Yoḥanan transmits.
rabbi-yosei-ben-zimra.prompt: A dignified elder in his 60s with a long white beard and a cream wool mantle, speaking softly with a finger to his lips; background of Tiberias study-hall arches with the Sea of Galilee faintly beyond.

mar-ukva.name: Mar Ukva
mar-ukva.bio: Babylonian Amora and head of the court in the time of Shmuel, remembered for giving charity in secret (Ketubot 67b).
mar-ukva.prompt: A distinguished man in his 60s with a neatly trimmed grey beard and a fine dark mantle, quietly slipping a coin pouch through a doorway; background of a Babylonian courtyard at dusk.

rabbi-chama-berabbi-chanina.name: Rabbi Ḥama son of Rabbi Ḥanina
rabbi-chama-berabbi-chanina.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel, son of Rabbi Ḥanina bar Ḥama of Tzippori, known for his aggadic teachings.
rabbi-chama-berabbi-chanina.prompt: A scholar in his 50s with a dark beard touched with grey and a plain cream mantle, holding a scroll of Proverbs open in both hands; background of Tzippori stone streets and arches.

rabbi-acha-berabbi-chanina.name: Rabbi Aḥa son of Rabbi Ḥanina
rabbi-acha-berabbi-chanina.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel, cited in the Talmud for aggadic teachings.
rabbi-acha-berabbi-chanina.prompt: A serious scholar in his 40s with a short dark beard and a simple grey mantle, reciting from a scroll of Psalms with a grave look; background of a Galilean study hall with olive trees through the window.
